data.title: 伽玛 · 咖啡馆新品试吃
data.description: 四越咖啡馆的吧台前，伽玛系着围裙试饮新调的饮品。她闭目细品片刻，店员们紧张地等她的评价——那将决定这款饮品的命运。
data.location: cozy trading company cafe interior with a wooden counter, cups and pastry displays
data.action: tasting a new drink at the counter with eyes closed, wearing a cafe apron, thoughtful expression
data.lighting: 咖啡馆午后透过格窗的柔和日光
data.promptProse: Apron on, Gamma tastes the cafe's new drink in silence while the staff hold their breath for her verdict.
data.animaCaption: One sip, three seconds of silence — the whole cafe waits on Gamma's palate.
